title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
slides: Can AI design the chips it runs on?
Ricursive Intelligence says yes—but the compute crisis demands it.
AI-designed chips cut design time from years to weeks.
This means startups can now compete with giants on custom silicon.
Test one AI-designed chip idea this quarter.
thread_text:
1. AI designs its own chips?

Ricursive Intelligence claims yes. The compute crisis means we might not have a choice.

2. Years to weeks

AI-designed chips slash development timelines. That changes who can afford to build custom silicon.

3. Startups vs. giants

The barrier to custom chip design just collapsed. Small teams can now compete with billion-dollar hardware divisions.

4. The real bottleneck

It's not design speed—it's fabrication access. Even with AI, you still need a foundry.

5. Try it this quarter

Pick one chip idea and simulate it with an AI design tool. If you haven't done it, start there.

script: Can AI design the chips it runs on?
Ricursive says yes, and compute crisis demands it.
Design time drops from years to weeks.
Startups can now compete on custom silicon.
Test one AI-designed chip idea this quarter.

instagram.caption:
Chip design just went from multi-year timelines to a few weeks. 🔧

Ricursive Intelligence is betting AI can design the very chips it runs on.

The compute crisis is the pressure forcing this shift.

That collapse in design time opens custom silicon to small teams, not just billion-dollar hardware divisions.

So if you build or publish in hardware, your road to a custom chip is shorter and cheaper than last year. ⚡

But here's the catch: design speed is solved, fabrication access isn't. You still need a foundry. 🏭

Which single chip idea would you simulate this quarter if it only took weeks? 🧠
